title: SourceCreate
description: API-key Source creation input. It extends the unsaved observation request with display and reconciliation data; the server still owns Source identity, protocol evidence, discovered inventory, health, usage, custody metadata, and timestamps. When client_nonce is present, the server reserves the Source.client_nonce uniqueness slot before observation or credential work and persists the same column unchanged on the committed Source, so a lost-response client can reconcile through the ordinary Source list without a receipt or separate endpoint.

vendor.description: Vendor id used by the response-backed observation.

display_name.description: Optional user-facing name. Omission uses the server's canonical vendor label.

base_url.description: null selects the vendor's official endpoint; a custom value selects a relay or self-hosted endpoint.

key.description: Transient plaintext credential. It is never returned or persisted in Source state.

protocol_order.description: Optional one-time probe order containing every protocol exactly once. It orders observation and never supplies a protocol conclusion.

client_nonce.description: Optional client-generated create correlation held before submission. The server atomically reserves the Source.client_nonce uniqueness slot before observation or credential work and persists that same column unchanged on the resulting Source; no separate claim record exists. A same-nonce retry receives an in-progress conflict, atomically reclaims a released slot, or receives a committed conflict and reconciles by finding that nonce in the ordinary Source list. It is not Source identity, credential material, or a routing input.
